title: Vault Bootstrap
description: Versioned structure containing only the information needed to open the vault. The password protects the random master key (it does NOT directly encrypt every object). Stored as the one discoverable bootstrap object under the random vault locator. Schema version 1. The `vaultId` field is authoritative for wrong-vault detection (FR edge case, clarified 2026-08-07): if a configured or newly-chosen repository contains a bootstrap whose `vaultId` does not match the locally-configured `vaultId`, the application MUST fail closed with a `wrongVault` error and MUST NOT modify any local or remote data. Argon2id parameters (FR-160c, clarified 2026-08-07): production vault bootstrapping MUST use memoryKiB >= 19456 (19 MiB), iterations >= 2, parallelism >= 1 (OWASP guidance). The schema minimums below (memoryKiB >= 8, iterations >= 1, parallelism >= 1) exist ONLY to permit deterministic unit-test fixtures that exercise envelope parsing without paying the full derivation cost; production bootstrapping MUST reject parameter sets weaker than the FR-160c minimums. Parameter values used at vault creation are stored here so future unlocks reproduce the derivation exactly.

formatVersion.description: Bootstrap format version (independent of schemaVersion for forward evolution).

vaultId.description: Random vault identity. Used as HKDF context.

vaultLocator.description: Random/opaque remote locator under which all vault objects live. Reveals nothing semantic.

argon2id.description: Argon2id parameters for deriving the key-encryption key (KEK) from the synchronization password. Production minimums (FR-160c): memoryKiB >= 19456, iterations >= 2, parallelism >= 1. Schema minimums below are for test fixtures only.

memoryKiB.description: Memory cost in KiB. Production: >= 19456 (FR-160c). Test fixtures: >= 8.

wrappedMasterKey.description: Master key wrapped (encrypted) with the password-derived KEK. Re-wrapping on password change replaces only this; unchanged objects are not re-encrypted.

keyConfirmation.description: Optional password-verification / key-confirmation material (not a password hint). Lets the app detect a wrong password before attempting object decryption.

encryptionSuiteVersion.description: Identifies the encryption suite (Argon2id KEK + HKDF-SHA-256 + AES-GCM). Bumping it is a MAJOR change.
